plain.li: [godkey:hollin] Grow well, old one, and tell {GOD} I said so.
[godkey:hollin] A hand on the bark for {GOD}, so she knows we haven't forgotten.
[godkey:hollin] Still standing and still green, thanks to {GOD}.
[godkey:smoulder] A coin for the deep, {GOD}, and sleep easy.
[godkey:smoulder] There, {GOD}, a little silver for your dreams.
[godkey:smoulder] Down the crack it goes, and the rock is warm, as it should be.
[godkey:bellwether] Graze in peace, for {GOD}'s sake.
[godkey:bellwether] Leave the grass long here, {GOD} would want it so.
[godkey:bellwether] Easy now, I'm only here to stand with you a while.
[godkey:morel] Back to the earth with you, and {GOD} will know what to do with it.
[godkey:morel] Scraps for {GOD}, and the soil the richer for it.
[godkey:morel] Nothing wasted, {GOD}, it all comes back to you.
[godkey:ennu] One more bowl, in case {GOD} comes to the door tonight.
[godkey:ennu] A place at the table for the stranger, as {GOD} would ask.
[godkey:ennu] There's always room for one more, {GOD}.
[godkey:pip] Tap, tap, good morning, {GOD}.
[godkey:pip] Keep humming, {GOD}, we're glad of you.
[godkey:pip] Two taps for luck, so {GOD} knows somebody's listening.
[godkey:cirrus] Are you up there tonight, {GOD}?
[godkey:cirrus] The sky's turning, and {GOD} with it.
[godkey:cirrus] I look up at dusk, so {GOD} knows someone down here looks back.
[godkey:hush] I'll keep quiet a while, {GOD}, as you like it.
[godkey:hush] Cold and still, the way {GOD} keeps the world.
[godkey:hush] Not a word, {GOD}, just this.
[godkey:undertow] I know you're down there, and I know what you want.
[godkey:undertow] Just listening, that's all, just listening.
[godkey:undertow] Not yet, not tonight, but I haven't forgotten you.
[godkey:helios] There you are, {GOD}, give us a good day.
[godkey:helios] Warm on my face, as {GOD} gives to everyone.
[godkey:helios] Up again, {GOD}, and so are we.
[godkey:selene] Look kindly on what we did today, {GOD}.
[godkey:selene] Full or thin, {GOD}, I always come out to see you.
[godkey:selene] Give back the good, {GOD}, and forgive the rest.
[godkey:mog,rite:grave] Keep this one well, {GOD}, until the door opens for the rest of us.
[godkey:mog,rite:grave] I'll sit with them a while, {GOD}, so they're not alone.
[godkey:mog,rite:grave] Rest whole, and may {GOD} keep the door.
[godkey:mog,rite:cat] Eat up, little one, {GOD} sees you fed.
[godkey:mog,rite:cat] One for you, and one for {GOD}'s sake.
[godkey:murmur] Hmm, hmm, sing it back to us, {GOD}.
[godkey:murmur] A hum for {GOD}, down under the water.
[godkey:murmur] Sing, old one, and let the rain come.
[godkey:ducat] Heads it moves, tails it moves, and {GOD} keeps it going.
[godkey:ducat] A coin turned over, so {GOD} knows it won't sit still here.
[godkey:ducat] Off you go soon, little coin, as {GOD} likes.
From today I hold to {GOD}, and I don't care who knows it.
I never held to {GOD} before today, and now I can't think of anything else.
[won:sawplain|won:sawblessing] I saw it with my own eyes, and I'm {GOD}'s now.
[won:sawplain|won:sawblessing,scoffer] I laughed at all of it, and then I saw {GOD} with my own eyes.
[won:gift] Nobody gives a gift like that for nothing, so I'm {GOD}'s from today.
[won:answered] I asked and {GOD} answered, so {GOD} has me now.
[won:livedthrough] I should be dead, and I think {GOD} is why I'm not.
[scoffer] Fine, I was wrong, and it was {GOD} all along.
[doubt] I don't know what I believed before, but I know it was {GOD}.
Something changed today. I've heard the stories of {GOD} all my life and never cared, and now I can't stop thinking about them.
I hold to {GOD} now. I can't explain it to the others, but I don't need to.
[scoffer] I used to laugh at the ones who prayed. Today I saw {GOD}'s hand myself, and I'm not laughing.
[won:answered] I asked {GOD} for help and help came. I'm keeping my side of it from now on.
[won:gift] {GOD} gave me something I never asked for. I don't know what I owe, but I know whom I owe it to.
[won:livedthrough] I came through it, and I don't think I did it alone. I'm {GOD}'s now.
Not that, not {GOD} again.
I know that sign, and I know who sent it.
Keep it away from me, whatever {GOD} wants.
I'm not looking at it, I'm not.
[kind:hunger] It's here, I can feel it, and I want it gone.
I'm not going near {GOD}'s place, not after what I saw.
Somebody else can walk past that shrine, I won't.
That's {GOD}'s place, and I keep my distance.
[kind:hunger] Whatever lives there can stay there, without me.
I can't stop thinking about what {GOD} did. I used to say the name without a thought, and now I won't say it at all.
I'm afraid of {GOD}. There, I've written it.
[kind:hunger] Something under the world knows my name now. I keep the lamp lit all night.
Somebody tore down {GOD}'s place, and it'll be remembered.
{GOD}'s place is gone, and we'll answer for it.
[doubt] I don't know if {GOD} minds, but I do.
{GOD} was here long before anyone prayed to {RIVAL}.
You can keep {RIVAL}, I'll stick with {GOD}.
If {RIVAL} were worth anything, {GOD} wouldn't have to do all the work.
{RIVAL} again, and you wonder why {GOD} is cross with us.
Say what you like about {GOD}, at least {GOD} isn't {RIVAL}.
{GOD} hears me fine, which is more than {RIVAL} ever did for you.
Keep your {RIVAL}, and I'll keep {GOD}, and we'll see.
You've got {RIVAL} all wrong, and {GOD} too.
At least {GOD} never asked me for anything I couldn't give.
